As of 22 November 2023: Audrey took all four dogs to a pet salon on Friday 17 Nov 2023; they were excited, behaved well in a new place (she usually worries about that), and looked great. Dogs are doing great, exploring and meeting new people.
Audrey has four dogs: Pepper, Precious, Panda and, newest, Pixie (a puppy adopted by 2 April 2023). She has had the first three for 3 years (as of 27 March 2023). They are city dogs, and she takes them on adventures to new parks and trails very often. She recently bought them new collars and tags. Pixie took a few days to settle in but now gets along great with the others; Pepper took a bit longer to adjust but is now always with Pixie. Audrey found her dog-friendly home using rental websites with pet-friendly filters. Walking them in the park helps her recharge. She has a tattoo of her dogs on her arm (got it a while ago), representing her love for her pups and nature's beauty.
As of 3 May 2023: the dogs go nuts for hikes (love new scents). Audrey bought them a special safety item (they look funny in it). On walks they play fetch with a ball or frisbee, and have doggie playdates at the dog park next to the park they usually walk. They sometimes wear party hats. Audrey went on a hike around late April 2023 and saw a hummingbird.
As of 6 May 2023: Audrey takes the dogs on road trips about once every couple of months; on Friday 28 April 2023 they visited a national park.
As of 11 May 2023: Audrey signed up for a positive reinforcement pet-bonding/training workshop (June 2023). She strongly believes in positive reinforcement and never punishment.
As of 2 June 2023: on 1 June she let the dogs run off-leash at the park. In late May 2023 she hiked a national park peak with the dogs at sunset.
As of 13 June 2023: about early June she found a new small park with a tree-lined trail and meadow; walks last about an hour. She invited Andrew to join.
As of 26 June 2023: Audrey moved to a new house with a bigger backyard; she set up a doggy play area with agility equipment and toys. She plans to check out a doggy daycare Andrew mentioned.
As of 3 July 2023: the dogs are all mutts, all 3 years old. Breeds (corrected 28 Oct 2023): Pepper and Panda are Lab mixes; Precious and Pixie are Chihuahua mixes. Audrey is taking a dog training course (time-consuming, paying off). Doggy playdate on Friday 30 June 2023.
As of 8 July 2023: she got her dogs from a breeder nearby. Hike with Andrew and the dogs planned for August 2023 (she's checking the trail is safe with room for off-leash running).
As of 11 July 2023: Audrey made personalized tags for each dog herself, fitting their personalities; she wants her pets to feel seen and loved. Andrew's new puppy Toby will meet her dogs at the August hike.
As of 27 July 2023: Personalities: oldest is relaxed like a wise old sage; second always ready for a game; third can be naughty but loves cuddles; youngest is full of life and up for adventure. Her childhood dog was Max, energetic and loved fetch; she took long neighborhood walks with him and confided in him. She has never been to an animal shelter but thinks she might volunteer someday.
As of 4 August 2023: Audrey just started agility classes with the dogs at a dog park; goes twice a week for practice. Recently did a 2-hour trail hike with them.
As of 16 August 2023: Audrey got another tattoo of her four dogs on her arm (so she may have more than one dog tattoo). Four dogs is enough for now; she wants to give each enough attention. Took all four to the vet for checkups; it was chaotic, so next time she'll bring them one by one. Favorite spots: Pepper on the couch, Pixie in her bed, Precious in her chair, Panda on his rug. They always nap cuddled together and are best friends.
As of 19 August 2023: Audrey took a dog grooming course in August 2023 and now grooms the dogs herself; tips: go slow and gentle, mind ears and paws, stay patient and positive. Weekend plan: stroll in the park with them.
As of 24 August 2023: grooming routine is daily brushing, regular baths, nail trims. Audrey has never been fishing but enjoys relaxing by mountain lakes (a few years ago with friends); shared a photo of the dogs at a mountain lake trip. Says she has a very strong bond with her dogs.
As of 6 September 2023: Audrey organized a doggy playdate with the neighbors' dogs recently, and bought the dogs new beds the week before (late Aug 2023) for the cooling weather; they love snuggling in them. She does at least one self-care activity daily.
As of 24 September 2023: On Friday 22 September 2023 at the park, Precious pulled so hard the leash broke; Audrey caught her safely and calmed her with petting and calm talk. She trains obedience and tricks (sit, stay, shake, roll over), and walks them multiple times a day. Bonding advice she gives: patience, regular training, praise successes. The dogs play in the garden; they only play with each other.
As of 4 October 2023: Audrey took the dogs to the beach over the weekend of 30 Sept-1 Oct 2023; they loved swimming and playing in the ocean.
As of 13 October 2023: Audrey made goodies for neighbors to thank them for their pup-friendly homes. Dogs love the dog park (fetch, frisbee, socializing) but hate snow (confused by it last winter). She added more drawings to her dog tattoo; says that's enough tattoos unless she gets another dog. Life has been crazy so she hasn't walked them much lately; wants to take them on a hike as therapy. Andrew suggested coffee at the dog park near a new cafe.
